name: The Hillside Caves
description: Small caves tucked into the hills of Aldermark.

hermit_cave.name: Hermit's Cave
hermit_cave.description: A low cave, warm from a small fire. A man sits by it as if he has always been there.

merchant_cave.name: Merchant's Cave
merchant_cave.description: Shelves cut into the stone hold bottles, scrolls and folded cloth.

fairy_pool.name: Fairy Pool
fairy_pool.description: A round pool glows from below. Motes of light drift above it.
